sources.title: GitHub - Helsinki-NLP/Opus-MT: Open neural machine translation models ...
sources.snippet: Train MT models There is a Makefile for training new models from OPUS data in the Opus-MT-train repository, but this is heavily customized for the work environment at CSC and the University of Helsinki projects. This will (hopefully) be more generic in the future to be able to run in different environments and setups as well.

sources.title: opus-mt-fr-en huggingface.co api & onnx-community opus-mt-fr-en github ...
sources.snippet: opus-mt-fr-en huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides opus-mt-fr-en's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this onnx-community opus-mt-fr-en model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the opus-mt-fr-en model, and also provides paid use of the opus-mt-fr-en. Support call opus-mt-fr-en model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.

sources.title: opus-mt-fr-en · Models
sources.snippet: Note: Having a separate repo for ONNX weights is intended to be a temporary solution until WebML gains more traction. If you would like to make your models web-ready, we recommend converting to ONNX using 🤗 Optimum and structuring your repo like this one (with ONNX weights located in a subfolder named onnx).
